#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int numOfDifLet(const std::string& s, int l, int r) {
    bool used[30] = {false};
    for (int i = l; i <= r; ++i) {
        used[s[i] - 'a'] = true;
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 30; ++i) {
        if (used[i]) ans++;
    }
    return ans;
}

int numOfDifLet(int a, int b, int l, int r) {
    int first = b < a ? b : a - 1;
    int last = a - 1;

    std::string sb;
    char ch = 'a';

    for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
        sb += ch;
        ch++;
    }

    ch = (l < a) ? sb[last] : sb[first];

    for (int i = 0; i < b; ++i) {
        sb += ch;
    }

    bool used[30] = {false};
    for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
        used[sb[sb.size() - i - 1] - 'a'] = true;
    }

    int ptr = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
        while (used[ptr]) ++ptr;
        sb += ('a' + ptr);
        used[ptr] = true;
    }

    ch = sb[std::min(b, a - 1) + a + b];

    for (int i = 0; i < b; ++i) {
        sb += ch;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < a + b; ++i) {
        sb += sb[i];
    }

    return numOfDifLet(sb, l, r);
}

int main() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    std::cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;
    l -= 1;
    r -= 1;

    int len = a + b;
    int dif = r - l;
    int ans;

    if (dif >= 2 * len) {
        ans = std::max(a + 1, 2 * a - b);
    } else {
        r -= len * (l / len);
        l %= len;
        ans = numOfDifLet(a, b, l, r);
    }

    std::cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
